sections.title: WHAT IS SMP FOR BALDNESS – SCALP MICROPIGMENTATION FOR MEN?
bullets: SMP for baldness (scalp micropigmentation) is a hair tattoo treatment that uses pigments to create the visual effect of dense hair. Unlike hair transplant, SMP treatment for baldness does not involve surgery, leaves no scars, and provides quick results.

Scalp micropigmentation for baldness in Ljubljana is designed for men with significant baldness (Norwood 3-7) or thinning hair who want a discreet solution without surgery. Hair tattoo is an ideal alternative to hair transplant.
SMP treatment for baldness is especially effective for men with short hair (1–2 mm), as the pigment blends perfectly with the natural scalp. The hair tattoo looks natural even up close.

Compared to a hair transplant that usually adds 3,000–5,000 hairs, SMP for baldness can cover the entire scalp with up to 60,000 pigment dots – creating a more even and visually denser hair tattoo result.
SMP treatment allows for a natural hairline design – individually adapted to the face and aesthetics. Scalp micropigmentation in Ljubljana ensures a natural look for men with baldness.
Hair tattoo (SMP for baldness) is a discreet solution performed in our Ljubljana SMP studio.
